space.0.$description: Zero spacing step, used to explicitly reset a spacing property.

radius.large.$description: Surface-level corner radius for cards, dialogs, and other large panels (12px).

radius.full.$description: Fully rounded corner radius for pills and circular controls.

shadow.small.$description: Hairline elevation for barely-raised surfaces. Gained a second hairline layer and higher alphas in this refinement pass (light 0.08 -> 0.1 plus a new 0.06 layer; dark 0.06 -> 0.09 plus a new 0.05 layer) for deeper, crisper elevation. Light and dark themes carry distinct explicit values (see the theme modifier documents) alongside this `light-dark()` recipe.

shadow.medium.$description: Mid elevation for raised surfaces such as popovers.

shadow.large.$description: High elevation for dialogs and drawers.

shadow.overlay.$description: Elevation for modal/drawer overlay panels. Dark mode uses a stronger black shadow rather than the light-neutral lift the other tiers use, since overlay panels sit above a dimmed backdrop rather than page content.

control.height.sm.$description: Small control height; the toolbar default (32px).

control.height.lg.$description: Large control height; clears the WCAG AAA touch target (44px).

font.mono.$description: Monospace font stack for code surfaces.

font.size.md.$description: Medium font size; the button ladder step between base and lg (15px).

leading.relaxed.$description: Relaxed line height for long-form reading.

tracking.tight.$description: Tight letter-spacing, -0.01em. Expressed as a unitless number with an em recipe because DTCG dimension units are limited to px and rem.

tracking.wide.$description: Wide letter-spacing, 0.02em. Expressed as a unitless number with an em recipe because DTCG dimension units are limited to px and rem.

type.tab-size.$description: Tab width for monospace/code surfaces (`variant="code"` on Input/Textarea, CodeBlock). Tab characters render as this many spaces' worth.

content.width.$description: Maximum inline size for primary page content. Caps line length and keeps content readable on wide viewports. Used by page layout styles; consumers can override per scope.

content.width.prose.$description: Prose column width, 65ch — caps line length at a readable measure. Expressed as a unitless number with a ch recipe because DTCG dimension units are limited to px and rem.

ease.spring.$description: A fast, settled ease-out with no overshoot. Previously cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) — a back-ease whose y1=1.56 overshot to 156% of travel, which on the sheet/drawer (100%-of-panel translate) flung the panel past the viewport edge before settling. This curve keeps the snappy decelerate-in feel with no overshoot.

motion.fast.$description: Fast interaction duration before a reduced-motion modifier applies.

motion.normal.$description: Alias of the base transition duration.

motion.pulse.$description: Repeating pulse animation duration, for the breathing opacity loop shared by status indicators and skeleton placeholders. Numerically equal to `motion.progress.ring.spin` today, but deliberately its own token: a pulse and a spinner are unrelated motions and either may be retuned without the other.

z.toast.$description: Toast layer, above modal so confirmations reach users even when a modal is open.

surface.base.$description: Default semantic surface. Theme modifiers provide its dark value.

surface.raised.$description: Elevated semantic surface. Theme modifiers provide its dark value.

surface.raised.hover.$description: Hover state of the raised surface. Light mode washes toward the accent; dark mode mixes toward white.

surface.raised.pressed.$description: Pressed state of the raised surface. Light mode washes toward the accent; dark mode mixes toward white.

surface.inset.$description: Sunken region inside a card body (code blocks, wells, recessed sub-regions).

surface.hover.$description: Hover state of the default surface. Light mode washes toward the accent rather than darkening toward black: once the light ramp is anchored at white, its four resting tiers occupy only 0.040 lightness points, so a proportional lightness-only mix would be wider than the whole ramp it has to stay clear of. A light-mode hover that washes toward the brand accent separates by chroma and hue as well, staying legible at a lightness step small enough to fit the ramp.

surface.pressed.$description: Pressed state of the default surface. Same accent-wash rationale as `surface.hover`, at a stronger mix percentage.

surface.inverse.$description: Inverse surface, used by Tooltip to stay a dark overlay in both themes. Light arm mirrors the text/surface swap (dark bg, light fg); dark arm uses the elevated surface + near-white text so the tooltip reads as a dark elevated layer rather than inverting to light.

surface.upcoming-marker.$description: Upcoming step marker background. Keeps the inset treatment in light mode (surface-inset is visibly recessed vs surface), but lifts to surface in dark mode where surface-inset is nearly invisible against the dark stage.

surface.canvas.$description: Page canvas background, distinct from `surface.base` (a card body). Sits on the surface ramp that runs inset -> bg -> surface -> raised. Light mode anchors that ramp at white (0.960 -> 0.984 -> 0.994 -> 1.000); dark mode runs the same ordering at low lightness.

border.control.$description: Functional control boundary that clears 3:1 against supported surfaces. It is the border of the secondary Button, whose fill is `surface.raised` -- white in light mode, a raised dark surface in dark mode -- so in both themes it is the only thing making that control read as a control. In light mode it must not be lightened past ~0.85 or it stops clearing 3:1 against that near-white fill.

border.faint.$description: Decorative-only hairline. Never use as a control boundary: it is intentionally below the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 non-text threshold.

border.muted.$description: Decorative divider that wants less weight than `border.control`. Clears a separate 1.4:1 floor against its backdrop.

border.strong.$description: Stronger control boundary. Clears WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 floor against every supported surface, like `border.control`.

border.inverse.$description: Border for surfaces using `surface.inverse` (Tooltip). Transparent in light mode; adds a 1px delineation in dark mode only.

text.disabled.$description: Disabled text color. Clears the 3:1 UI floor in both themes even though disabled controls are exempt from WCAG text contrast; a disabled control still has to be visible as a control.

fill.disabled.$description: Neutral fill for disabled solid controls (disabled-checked checkbox/radio) so they stop misusing `text.disabled` (a text-lightness token) as an assertive fill. The glyph on top must use `text.disabled`, not `accent.contrast`: accent-contrast is dark ink in both arms and would be near-invisible on the dark-arm fill.

accent.contrast.$description: Label color for solid accent fills. Light arm flips to white (the indigo fill is dark enough); dark arm keeps dark ink against the bright dark-mode fill.

accent.text.$description: Accent used as text/icon on light surfaces. The light-mode fill accent (L=0.50) reads as a foreground at only ~4.7:1, just clearing AA, so this dedicated, slightly darker foreground token stays necessary for comfortable link/icon legibility. The dark arm matches the dark-mode accent fill.

accent.text.hover.$description: Hover step for text/icon links, derived as a darker step of `accent.text` (not the bright fill-derived `accent.solid.hover`, which is lighter than the resting text color and drops below WCAG AA on near-white).

accent.solid.active.$description: Active/pressed step for solid accent fills, derived as a darker step of `accent.solid` (l - 0.15, c and h held constant).

accent.solid.active.on-fill.$description: Pressed fill for solid accent surfaces that carry the `accent.contrast` label (primary Button, FloatingAction). Kept distinct from `accent.solid.active` so label-bearing and non-label consumers can diverge if ever needed.

accent.solid.hover.$description: Hover step for solid accent fills, derived as a darker step of `accent.solid` (l - 0.08, c and h held constant).

accent.background.$description: Soft accent-tinted background, mixed 88% toward the current surface.

accent.border.$description: Soft accent-tinted border, the accent color mixed 60% toward transparent.

ring.width.$description: Focus ring stroke width. A floor, not a preference: WCAG 2.4.13 wants an indicator at least as large as a 2px-thick perimeter of the control.

ring.offset.$description: Focus ring offset from the control edge.

ring.offset-color.$description: Focus ring offset band color. The ring is a two-stop box-shadow and box-shadow cannot paint a transparent gap, so the offset band has to be some real color. Pinned to `surface.raised` (the top of the ramp) so the band disappears into raised surfaces, where controls overwhelmingly live, and reads as a light halo on recessed tiers.

ring.color.$description: Focus ring color, relative to `accent.solid` so a consumer override re-derives the ring hue. Light arm clamps L to 0.55 for 3.56:1 against the widened ramp's darkest surface; `h` tracks the accent hue.

ring.on-accent.$description: Ring color tuned for use on solid accent/fill surfaces (FloatingAction primary variant). Light arm is a near-black that contrasts both the accent fill and the page background; dark arm is a near-white that contrasts the bright dark-mode accent and the dark page background.

status.success.solid.active.$description: Active/pressed step for solid success fills.

status.success.solid.hover.$description: Hover step for solid success fills.

status.success.text.$description: Foreground color on the soft success surface.

status.success.border.$description: Border color on the soft success surface.

status.danger.contrast.$description: Label color for solid danger fills. Dark-mode danger is ~72% lightness; pure white fails WCAG AA on it, so the dark arm uses a near-black ink instead.

status.danger.solid.active.$description: Active/pressed step for solid danger fills, explicitly authored and fitted to the in-gamut chroma maximum at this lightness.

status.danger.solid.hover.$description: Hover step for solid danger fills, explicitly authored and fitted to the in-gamut chroma maximum at this lightness.

status.info.solid.hover.$description: Hover step for solid info fills.

status.info.muted.$description: Info color moved toward the current surface. Derived in one polarity-aware recipe shared by all four status colors.

status.neutral.background.$description: Soft neutral-tinted surface background. Neutral retains the status-triple shape so components never need ad hoc surface mixing for the default variant.

status.neutral.text.$description: Foreground color on the soft neutral surface.

status.neutral.border.$description: Border color on the soft neutral surface.

checker.base.$description: Transparency checkerboard base tile, shared by color-domain components. Light mode preserves the historical white/gray grid; dark mode keeps the pattern visible without flashing a white backing inside dark chrome.

button.height.xs.$description: Extra-small button height (24px), aliasing the shared control-height tier.

toggle.track.off-resting.$description: Toggle track color in the off, resting state. Light arm preserves the `border.muted` look; dark arm raises lightness for >=3:1 shape contrast against the surface.

toggle.track.off-hover-resting.$description: Toggle track color in the off state on hover. Steps up from `off-resting` to be distinguishable.
